introduction: Patch registration (POST /workspaces/:slug/patches and afc patch add) resolves a submitted branch_name against a local branch, the fork's tracking ref, or a single-branch fetch from the fork, so a branch that exists on GitHub but has no local ref yet in the hub's trunk clone can be registered as a patch without --skip-branch-check, in either PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE mode, with the resolving path recorded in the hub.patch.create audit event.

glossary.PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE: Workspace variable, delivered by 02_fork_authoritative_sync, selecting the authority for patch branches: 'hub' (default) or 'origin'.
glossary.branch-check hook: The BranchCheckFunc registered from main.go (internal/workspace/branch_check_hook.go) that internal/workspace calls to validate branch_name at registration time, extended by this spec from a single rev-parse into the three-step resolution.
glossary.branch_resolution: The path that found a submitted branch_name during registration: local (already refs/heads/<name>), origin_tracking (promoted from refs/remotes/origin/<name>), or origin_fetch (found only after a single-branch fetch from the fork).
glossary.carry-patch workspace: A workspace in workspace_mode 'carry_patch', with a trunk clone holding an 'origin' remote (the fork) and an 'upstream' remote.
glossary.single-branch fetch: A go-git fetch of exactly one refspec, +refs/heads/<name>:refs/remotes/origin/<name>, from the origin remote, attempted only in PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin mode when neither ref exists locally.
glossary.tracking ref: refs/remotes/origin/<name>, the fork's copy of a branch as last fetched into the trunk clone.
glossary.wslock: The per-workspace mutual-exclusion lock (internal/wslock) that sync, reclone, rebuild and this spec's ref-writing resolution steps acquire before touching the trunk clone.

requirements.title: Three-step branch resolution order
requirements.rationale: A branch that already exists on the fork must be registrable without first being pushed through the hub, in both authority modes, while the common already-local case stays exactly as fast and unlocked as it is today.

criteria.condition: a registration request's branch_name resolves refs/heads/<name> to an existing ref in the trunk clone and skip_branch_check is not true
criteria.action: resolve the branch under resolution local without writing any ref, acquiring the workspace lock, or performing a fetch
criteria.contract: the rev-parse --verify check succeeds and registration proceeds using resolution local

criteria.condition: a registration request's branch_name has no refs/heads/<name> but refs/remotes/origin/<name> exists in the trunk clone, and skip_branch_check is not true
criteria.action: create refs/heads/<name> at the tracking ref's commit using git update-ref refs/heads/<name> <tracking-ref sha>, never checkout or git branch, and resolve the branch under resolution origin_tracking
criteria.contract: refs/heads/<name> points at the same commit as refs/remotes/origin/<name>; the trunk's working tree and current HEAD are unchanged

criteria.condition: a registration request's branch_name has neither refs/heads/<name> nor refs/remotes/origin/<name> in the trunk clone and skip_branch_check is not true
criteria.guard: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to origin for the request's workspace
criteria.action: fetch +refs/heads/<name>:refs/remotes/origin/<name> from the origin remote using the credentials workspace.ResolveCloneAuth resolves, then repeat the refs/remotes/origin/<name> check and, when it now exists, create refs/heads/<name> as in 03-REQ-1.2 and resolve the branch under resolution origin_fetch
criteria.contract: on success, refs/heads/<name> and refs/remotes/origin/<name> both exist at the fetched commit and registration proceeds using resolution origin_fetch

criteria.condition: a registration request begins branch resolution and skip_branch_check is not true
criteria.action: read PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE fresh for that request rather than reusing a value read for an earlier request
criteria.contract: two requests for the same workspace made after PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE changes observe the new value on the later request

criteria.condition: reading PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE for a registration request is unset or the read itself fails
criteria.action: treat PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE as hub for that request's resolution, matching how every other on/off carry-patch workspace variable in this codebase defaults on a read error
criteria.contract: resolution proceeds through 03-REQ-1.1 and 03-REQ-1.2 only; 03-REQ-1.3's fetch is not attempted

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to hub for the request
criteria.action: skip the single-branch fetch of 03-REQ-1.3 even when neither refs/heads/<name> nor refs/remotes/origin/<name> exists locally
criteria.contract: no network call is made and no refs/remotes/origin/<name> is created by registration in hub mode

requirements.title: Combined not-found failure
requirements.rationale: Callers need one predictable failure shape regardless of which of the three attempts ran, naming both places checked.

criteria.condition: none of the local, origin_tracking, and (in origin mode) origin_fetch resolutions of 03-REQ-1 find a single-object request's branch_name
criteria.action: reject the request without inserting a patches row
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with body {"error": "branch does not exist in repository or on origin"}; any local branch created by an earlier successful step for this same request is not applicable since none succeeded

criteria.condition: none of the local, origin_tracking, and (in origin mode) origin_fetch resolutions of 03-REQ-1 find element i's branch_name during batch validation
criteria.action: reject the whole batch without inserting any row from it
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with body {"error": "patch[<i>]: branch does not exist in repository or on origin"}, where <i> is the failing element's index

requirements.title: skip_branch_check bypasses all resolution
requirements.rationale: skip_branch_check must keep its exact current meaning so existing callers relying on it are unaffected.

criteria.condition: skip_branch_check is true on a registration request, single or batch element
criteria.action: perform none of 03-REQ-1's ref reads, branch creation, or fetch for that request or element
criteria.contract: no ref is read or written, no network call is made, and validation proceeds directly to the existing duplicate and position checks

criteria.action: for any request with skip_branch_check true, produce the same branch-resolution outcome (none attempted) regardless of PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE and regardless of whether the request is a single object or a batch element

requirements.title: Workspace lock around mutating resolution steps
requirements.rationale: Creating a local branch or fetching from the fork writes refs and touches the network, so it needs the same per-workspace exclusion sync, reclone and rebuild already require, while the unchanged read-only fast path stays unlocked.

criteria.condition: registration is about to perform 03-REQ-1.2's branch creation or 03-REQ-1.3's fetch and branch creation for a branch_name
criteria.action: acquire the workspace's wslock before writing any ref or starting the fetch
criteria.contract: wslock.TryLock is called before the first ref write or network call of the mutating step

criteria.condition: wslock.TryLock for the workspace fails because another operation already holds it
criteria.action: abort the registration request before any git write or database write
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with error_type workspace_busy; no ref is written and no patches row is inserted

criteria.condition: the resolution phase of a request or batch finishes, whether it found the branch or not
criteria.action: release the workspace lock before the patches row is inserted
criteria.contract: the lock is not held while addPatchWithPosition or addPatchesBatch runs

criteria.action: take no workspace lock for 03-REQ-1.1's rev-parse --verify check, exactly as the pre-existing check does today

requirements.title: Batch resolution semantics
requirements.rationale: Batch registration must resolve every element before any row is inserted while keeping its existing fail-fast, all-or-nothing behaviour, and must not roll back a harmless local branch a successful earlier element left behind.

criteria.condition: handleAddPatchBatch validates a submitted array of patch objects
criteria.action: apply 03-REQ-1's resolution to every element, in submitted order, under one workspace-lock acquisition, before building any row to insert
criteria.contract: the lock from 03-REQ-4.1 is acquired at most once for the whole batch's resolution phase

criteria.condition: resolution under 03-REQ-2.2 fails for element i of a batch
criteria.action: stop resolving at element i without resolving or inserting any later element
criteria.contract: the 400 response names index i; no row for any element of the batch is inserted

criteria.action: leave in place any local branch that 03-REQ-1.2 or 03-REQ-1.3 created for an element earlier in the batch than one that later fails resolution

criteria.condition: every element of a batch resolves successfully
criteria.action: release the workspace lock before performing the existing atomic insert of all rows
criteria.contract: addPatchesBatch runs without the workspace lock held

requirements.title: Audit metadata for the resolved branch path
requirements.rationale: hub.patch.create must let an operator see which of the three paths, if any, resolved a registered patch's branch, in both the single and batch call sites.

criteria.condition: handleAddPatchSingle inserts a patch whose branch was resolved by 03-REQ-1
criteria.action: include branch_resolution, one of local, origin_tracking or origin_fetch, in the hub.patch.create event's metadata alongside the existing branch_name and position
criteria.contract: the emitted event's metadata contains all three keys

criteria.condition: handleAddPatchBatch inserts the rows of a resolved batch
criteria.action: emit one hub.patch.create event per inserted patch, each carrying that patch's branch_name, position and branch_resolution
criteria.contract: the number of hub.patch.create events emitted equals the number of rows inserted by the batch

criteria.condition: skip_branch_check bypassed resolution for an inserted patch under 03-REQ-3
criteria.action: omit branch_resolution from that patch's hub.patch.create metadata
criteria.contract: the metadata object has no branch_resolution key for that event

criteria.action: for any inserted patch whose branch was resolved by 03-REQ-1, record a branch_resolution value equal to the specific one of local, origin_tracking or origin_fetch that found its branch_name

requirements.title: Credential-resolution failure is distinct from not-found
requirements.rationale: A secrets-store failure while resolving fork credentials for the single-branch fetch is an infrastructure error, not evidence the branch is missing, and must fail loudly the same way sync's equivalent failure already does.

criteria.condition: resolving the fork's credentials for 03-REQ-1.3's fetch fails with a genuine secrets-store error, not the absence of configured credentials
criteria.action: abort the registration request without attempting the fetch and without inserting any patches row
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message "credential resolution failed"; for a batch, the response also identifies the failing element's index; no ref is written

criteria.action: treat the absence of configured fork credentials (no GIT_PAT and no GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD) as resolving to no auth for the fetch, identically to workspace.ResolveCloneAuth's existing contract, rather than as a credential-resolution failure

criteria.condition: 03-REQ-1.3's fetch itself fails for any reason other than credential resolution, including the branch being absent on the fork or a transient network error
criteria.action: treat the failure as step origin_fetch not resolving the branch and continue to 03-REQ-2's not-found failure rather than returning 502
criteria.contract: the request's eventual failure, if any, is the HTTP 400 of 03-REQ-2.1 or 03-REQ-2.2, never a 502

requirements.title: Documentation of the resolution order and new failure message
requirements.rationale: Callers reading the API and workflow docs must find the three-step resolution and the corrected 400 message rather than the retired single-check behaviour.

criteria.action: describe, in docs/api.md's POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patches section, the three-step resolution order of 03-REQ-1 and the 400 message text of 03-REQ-2
describe, in docs/openapi.yaml's addPatches operation, the same three-step resolution order and 400 message text as docs/api.md

replace docs/carry_patch_workflow.md's "3. Add patches" statement that branches are validated against the workspace repository at add time with one or two sentences describing the tracking-ref promotion and, in origin mode, the single-branch fetch fallback

execution_paths.title: Registering a patch whose branch exists only as the fork's tracking ref

steps.action: runs afc patch add with a branch_name that was fetched into refs/remotes/origin/<name> by the initial clone but never became a local branch
validates the carry_patch workspace and invokes the branch-check hook instead of the old rev-parse-only check
finds no refs/heads/<name>, finds refs/remotes/origin/<name>, acquires the workspace lock, and creates refs/heads/<name> at the tracking ref's commit via update-ref, resolution origin_tracking
releases the lock, inserts the patch row, and emits a hub.patch.create audit event carrying branch_resolution=origin_tracking
receives HTTP 201 with the created patch from afc patch add

execution_paths.title: Origin-mode single-branch fetch resolves a branch pushed to the fork moments ago

steps.action: pushes a new branch directly to the GitHub fork without pushing it through the hub's git server
calls POST /workspaces/:slug/patches with that branch_name on a workspace whose PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is origin

finds neither refs/heads/<name> nor refs/remotes/origin/<name>, acquires the workspace lock, and fetches +refs/heads/<name>:refs/remotes/origin/<name> from origin using the credentials workspace.ResolveCloneAuth resolves
re-checks the tracking ref, finds it now present, creates refs/heads/<name> via update-ref, resolution origin_fetch, and releases the lock
inserts the patch row and returns HTTP 201, with the hub.patch.create audit event recording branch_resolution=origin_fetch

execution_paths.title: Batch registration is all-or-nothing when one element's branch cannot be found anywhere

steps.action: calls POST /workspaces/:slug/patches with a batch array of three patch objects
resolves element 0 as local (already a local branch) and element 1 as origin_tracking, creating a local branch for element 1 under the workspace lock
fails to resolve element 2's branch under any of the three attempts and returns HTTP 400 naming patch[2], inserting no row for the batch
observes that the local branch created for element 1 was left in place despite the batch failing
retries the batch with element 2 corrected; the hub inserts all three rows atomically and emits three hub.patch.create audit events, each with its own branch_resolution

execution_paths.title: A concurrent sync holding the workspace lock defers registration's mutation attempt

steps.action: acquires the workspace's wslock while fetching upstream and, in origin mode, the fork
calls POST /workspaces/:slug/patches for a branch that requires creating a local branch from the tracking ref
fails to acquire the workspace lock and returns without reading or writing any ref
rejects the request with HTTP 409 and error_type workspace_busy, writing no ref and inserting no patch row
retries after the sync completes, and the same request now succeeds with resolution origin_tracking
